Hi James — thanks for the clear checklist. Answers and links below; attaching a one-page summary (redwood_slo_summary.pdf).

1) Uptime definition:
   - "Uptime" = data-plane request success rate measured at the ingress proxy for customer-specific routes (HTTP 2xx/3xx). Control-plane operations (deployments, config API) are tracked separately and are not counted in the data-plane uptime SLO.

2) Measurement windows:
   - We report rolling 30-day and 90-day SLO windows for internal monitoring; procurement requests typically use a 30-day rolling window for contractual language.

3) Latency:
   - We publish p50/p95/p99 for end-to-end request latency (client request to first-byte and request-to-completion for generation). Default published metrics assume 256 token context and a 1–8 token completion sample; if you need a different profile, we can surface custom histograms.

4) Alerting
   - Customer-facing thresholds: we alert when rolling 30d uptime slips below 99.5% (severity P2) or when p99 latency exceeds agreed threshold for two consecutive 1h windows (P1 if impacting traffic).
   - Escalation: on-call -> SRE lead -> CS/AM. We provide an incident summary to customers for any SLA-impacting event.

5) Customer access
   - Yes — we can provide read-only Grafana for customer SLO dashboards and a read-only Prometheus query endpoint. RBAC: "account-viewer" role with metrics-only permissions (no access to logs or API keys). You can limit to specific routes/models.

6) Evidence & retention
   - Sample dashboards: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleSharedDashboard
   - Raw telemetry retention: 90 days for full resolution metrics, aggregated rollups for 365 days.

Exception path for migration window:
   - We accept formal exception requests via a signed addendum (procurement addendum) that includes: affected routes, expected traffic delta, start/end dates, and a rollback plan. Exceptions are evaluated by SRE + Legal; small exceptions (<=72 hours) can be approved by SRE lead and AM; anything longer requires VP Ops approval. Please attach the proposed dates and traffic plan and we will route for approval.

Next steps:

   - Please confirm who should get the Grafana invite.
